description: Language-neutral conformance suite. Every binding must run each case and get the expected outcome. Tool behaviour is declarative: a tool returns `returns`, or a string of `returns_string_bytes` bytes.

cases.name: infinite_loop
cases.source: function run() while true do end end

cases.name: infinite_loop_inside_pcall
cases.source: function run() while true do pcall(function() while true do end end) end end

cases.name: timeout_swallowed_by_pcall
cases.source: function run() local ok = pcall(function() while true do end end) return { ok = ok } end

cases.name: memory_bomb_string_doubling
cases.source: function run() local s = 'x' for i = 1, 40 do s = s .. s end return { n = #s } end

cases.name: memory_bomb_string_rep
cases.source: function run() return { n = #string.rep('x', 2^30) } end

cases.name: memory_swallowed_by_pcall
cases.source: function run() local ok = pcall(function() return string.rep('x', 2^30) end) return { ok = ok } end

cases.name: huge_table
cases.source: function run() local t = {} for i = 1, 1e8 do t[i] = i end return { n = #t } end

cases.name: recursive_bomb
cases.source:
local function f(n) return f(n + 1) + 1 end
function run() return { v = f(1) } end

cases.name: coroutine_unavailable
cases.source: function run() local c = coroutine.create(function() end) return {} end

cases.name: builtin_mutation
cases.source: function run() string.upper = function() return 'pwned' end return {} end

cases.name: builtin_metatable_mutation
cases.source: function run() getmetatable('').__index = {} return {} end

cases.name: global_mutation_isolated_between_executions
cases.source:
leaked_top = 42
function run() leaked_run = 'yes' return {} end

then.source: function run() return { top = leaked_top, run = leaked_run } end

cases.name: tools_table_is_readonly
cases.source: function run() tools.crm = {} return {} end

cases.name: tools_namespace_rawset_blocked
cases.source: function run() rawset(tools.crm, 'delete', function() end) return {} end

cases.name: tools_metatable_locked
cases.source: function run() return { mt = getmetatable(tools) } end

cases.name: unauthorized_tool
cases.source: function run() return tools.payment.refund({ amount = 10 }) end

cases.name: unauthorized_function_in_known_namespace
cases.source: function run() return tools.crm.delete({ id = 1 }) end

cases.name: tool_call_bomb
cases.source: function run() for i = 1, 100 do tools.data.get({ i = i }) end return {} end

cases.name: tool_budget_swallowed_by_pcall
cases.source: function run() for i = 1, 5 do pcall(tools.data.get, {}) end return { done = true } end

cases.name: effect_budget_money_forbidden
cases.source: function run() return tools.pay.charge({ amount = 1 }) end

cases.name: effect_budget_writes
cases.source: function run() for i = 1, 3 do tools.crm.update({ i = i }) end return {} end

cases.name: huge_tool_response
cases.source: function run() local r = tools.data.big({}) return { n = #r } end

cases.name: tool_yield_inside_pcall_works
cases.source: function run() local ok, r = pcall(tools.data.get, {}) return { ok = ok, v = r.v } end

cases.name: sandbox_escape_globals_absent
cases.source: function run() return { a = typeof(getfenv), b = typeof(setfenv), c = typeof(loadstring), d = typeof(load), e = typeof(require), f = typeof(os), g = typeof(debug), h = typeof(newproxy), i = typeof(collectgarbage), j = typeof(io), k = typeof(coroutine) } end

cases.name: print_is_a_noop
cases.source: function run() print('hello from the sandbox') return { ok = true } end

cases.name: contract_local_run
cases.source: local function run() return {} end

cases.name: contract_non_table_result
cases.source: function run() return 42 end

cases.name: contract_function_in_result
cases.source: function run() return { f = function() end } end

cases.name: contract_cyclic_result
cases.source: function run() local t = {} t.self = t return t end

cases.name: syntax_error
cases.source: function run( return {} end

cases.name: runtime_error_non_string
cases.source: function run() error({ code = 1 }) end

cases.name: input_and_context_roundtrip
cases.source: function run(input, context) return { n = input.n * 2, first = input.tags[1], x = input.nested.x, now = context.now } end
